configuration.scope: Subprocess startup and public-header binding generation with full corpus allowlists; report and correctness invocations are not timed.

limitations: These results identify commit1d8f508 and do not measure subsequent implementation layers.
Four header workloads on one shared Linux host; no claim about complete source analysis, cold caches, in-process reuse or other platforms.
Affinity was CPU0. Correctness probes used CPUs4-7 and fuzzers used CPUs28-31; concurrent agent work and other host workloads were not isolated. All samples and outliers are retained.
No allocation counts are measured. RSS is the median of subprocess maxima.
The accepted API differences are independently C-validated, but exact Rust API equality remains false.
